_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
U na Mmoja {player_id} mo kgwelenya ya bararo ya Tic Tac Toe.
Semelo sa hao ke '{symbol}'.
Ua etsa ditshepele tsa hao tsa go hloma semelo sa hao mo kgwele ya 5x5 go bopa lekala la bone.
Lekala le ka ba lehalale, le ka ba lewopa, kapa le ka ba leboteng.
Naya kgopele ya hao ka tshepele '[4]' go bopa sepetle 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopeho sa ho falla se fosahetseng.Sebedisa "[cell]" moo sele e leng 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomoro ea sele e sa sebetseng: {cell}. E tlameha ho ba pakeng tsa 0 le {max_cell} .
invalid_move.already_occupied: Sele {cell} e se ntse e na le motho.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Sebapali {player_id} se entse motsamao o sa nepahalang.

game_action.placed: Mmoja {player_id} o hloma semelo sa hae ({symbol}) mo sepetle ({row}, {col}).
